theme_context.design_style: Classic Oscars glamour, Awwwards Site-of-the-Day level, editorial asymmetry, generous spacing

primary_heading.usage: Hero headers, Manifesto numbers, Section titles. Must use tight tracking (tracking-tighter) for sizes > 32px.

secondary_body.usage: Body text, small labels, countdown numbers. Wide tracking (tracking-[0.2em]) for overlines and uppercase labels.

textures: Subtle SVG noise overlay across the entire page to kill digital flatness and enhance the cinematic film grain feel (opacity 2-3%).
glows: Gold-on-dark glow treatments. Use drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(212,175,55,0.4)] on primary gold text or active elements.

surfaces.glassmorphism: Use the 'Crystal Variant' for sticky header and RSVP card. bg-[#131a2c]/60, backdrop-blur-2xl, border border-[#d4af37]/20.

layouts_and_grids.general: Never center everything. Asymmetry creates tension. Use generous spacing (py-24 to py-32 for sections).
layouts_and_grids.gallery_grid: MODE A: THE TETRIS GRID. Asymmetric layout with spanning columns (e.g., col-span-4 row-span-2 vs col-span-2 row-span-1) on a 12-column grid. Gaps should be gap-8 to gap-12.
layouts_and_grids.manifesto_layout: Overlapping editorial layout. Huge numbers (01, 02) set in gold, intersecting with paragraph text.

hero.description: Large kinetic hero with 3D canvas centerpiece. Text must be masked line-by-line on-load reveal using framer-motion.
hero.layout: Absolute positioned typography behind and in front of the 3D canvas for depth.

countdown.styling: Massive tabular numbers. Gold text, delicate dividers between days/hours/minutes.

editorial_marquee.styling: react-fast-marquee, Cormorant Garamond, text-6xl, text-transparent with gold border (stroke), heavily spaced (gap-32).

rsvp_form.styling: Shadcn form components stripped of default look. Dark inputs with gold bottom borders (border-b), no full outlines. Submit button should have gold hover glow.

motion.scroll: MUST use @studio-freight/react-lenis for smooth momentum scrolling. It adds weight and premium feel.
motion.reveals: Framer-motion section scroll-reveals (initial opacity 0, y 40, transition duration 1s, ease [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1]).
motion.text_masking: For hero text: Wrap lines in overflow-hidden spans. Animate inner text from y: 100% to y: 0%.

3d_libraries.implementation: Build a stylized, abstract 3D golden statuette centerpiece. DO NOT use external GLTF models. Assemble it purely from R3F primitives (e.g., a Cylinder for the base, elongated Capsules/Cylinders for legs and torso, a Sphere for the head, holding a Box/Cylinder sword).
3d_libraries.materials: Use MeshStandardMaterial with high metalness (1.0), moderate roughness (0.2), and color='#d4af37'.
3d_libraries.lighting: Cinematic lighting is CRITICAL. Use directional lights, a subtle ambient light, and Environment preset='city' (with low intensity) to create intense specular gold highlights against the dark blue background.

image_urls.description: Stylish woman in suit and cape on red carpet
Hollywood theatre lit up at night
A number of oscar statues on a table

media.icons: lucide-react for UI interactions. Use with minimal stroke widths (1px or 1.5px) for elegance.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure gold text against #131a2c meets WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Execute all styling in JS/Tailwind. Do not write .tsx files (the project uses .js).
Install required dependencies: @react-three/fiber, @react-three/drei, three, framer-motion, @studio-freight/react-lenis, react-fast-marquee.
Set up a global noise overlay (fixed pointer-events-none div with SVG filter) to add film grain.
For the 3D statuette: compose it meticulously using <Cylinder>, <Sphere>, <Box> from drei. Wrap it in a <Float> component for a majestic hovering effect.
Use optical alignment and negative space aggressively. Let the layout breathe with py-32 for major sections.
Avoid typical centered-text SaaS layouts. Use a strong left-aligned editorial baseline and push images into asymmetrical grid columns.
Implement masked text reveals for the hero: overflow-hidden wrapping motion.div elements translating Y.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Break standard grid rules intentionally.
Never center align the root App container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Use glass-morphism effects carefully; no fully transparent backgrounds over dynamic content.
Create depth through layered z-index hierarchy and parallax.
Avoid default transition: all. Target specific properties.
Use pre-existing Shadcn components where applicable, but override their aesthetic to match the dark cinematic theme (e.g., stripping default Vercel-like borders).
Never use placeholder image services. Only use the Unsplash URLs provided.
Every interaction needs micro-animations: hover, focus, entrance.
